nodes.label: Plugin Configuration
nodes.responsibility: Reads enabled plugin names from beets config and filters disabled ones.

nodes.label: Plugin Loader
nodes.responsibility: Imports plugin modules and instantiates each plugin, storing instances globally.

nodes.label: Command Aggregator
nodes.responsibility: Collects Subcommand objects from each loaded plugin instance via plugin.commands().

nodes.label: Command Registrar
nodes.responsibility: Adds collected subcommands to the CLI argument parser's subcommand list.

nodes.label: CLI Executor
nodes.responsibility: Parses the chosen subcommand from user input and invokes its callback function.

nodes.label: Runtime Override
nodes.responsibility: Allows --plugins and --disable-plugins CLI options to modify the plugin list at runtime.

question_overlay.summary: A plugin named in configuration becomes an executable CLI command by: reading its name from config (optionally overridden at runtime), loading its module and instantiating it, collecting its Subcommand objects, registering them with the argument parser, and finally parsing user input to invoke the command's callback.
